Synopsis:
    The Trump administration's DOJ and Education Department allege UC Berkeley School of Law used race-conscious tactics favoring Black applicants over white and Asian candidates, citing 5.8x higher admission odds for Black vs. white applicants in 2025. The school denies wrongdoing. DOJ seeks a voluntary resolution agreement. This is part of a broader, escalating federal campaign targeting university DEI programs, admissions practices, and funding — extending a pattern set by the 2023 SCOTUS ruling against affirmative action.
